scope: Additional safe classroom experiment concepts only.

experiments.title: Ice melting observation
experiments.focus: Show that a solid can change into a liquid without becoming a different substance.
student_observations: The ice gets smaller over time.
Temperature can help describe the change.
experiments.teacher_note: Use this to introduce phase change vocabulary.

experiments.title: Soap and water surface tension
experiments.focus: Show how a small amount of soap can change how water behaves at the surface.
student_observations: The water can behave differently after soap is added.
Some changes are physical, not chemical.
experiments.teacher_note: Good for discussing surface tension and everyday mixtures.

experiments.title: Salt water evaporation
experiments.focus: Show that when water leaves a solution, the dissolved solid can remain behind.
student_observations: The water level can go down over time.
Solid may remain in the container.
experiments.teacher_note: Connect this with everyday drying and crystallization ideas.

experiments.title: Crystallization review
experiments.focus: Review how a dissolved substance can reappear when the solvent is removed.
student_observations: A clear solution can turn into a solid again.
Crystals can form from the same substance.
Solutions are reversible in some classroom models.
experiments.teacher_note: Keep the model conceptual and classroom-safe.
